body.name: Label-preserving half-effect schedule prior
body.construction: Draw \(X\) with density \(f\), set \(\alpha=n^{-1/3}X\), and condition on \(|\alpha|<1/3\). Independently across labelled units draw response types according to \(p_t(\alpha)\). The induced law on complete schedules is \(\Pi_{A,n}\).
